title: type ARC
ARC.Get
content:
Get a value from cache pool using key if it exists. If not exists and it has LoaderFunc, it will generate the value using you have specified LoaderFunc method returns value.

func  Get(key interface{}) (interface{}, error)

title: ARC.GetALL
content:
GetALL returns all key-value pairs in the cache.

func  GetALL(checkExpired bool) map[interface{}]interface{}

title: ARC.GetIFPresent
content:
GetIFPresent gets a value from cache pool using key if it exists.
If it does not exists key, returns KeyNotFoundError.
And send a request which refresh value for specified key if cache object has LoaderFunc.

func  GetIFPresent(key interface{}) (interface{}, error)

title: ARC.Has
content:
Has checks if key exists in cache

func  Has(key interface{}) bool

title: ARC.Keys
content:
Keys returns a slice of the keys in the cache.

func  Keys(checkExpired bool) []interface{}

title: ARC.Len
content:
Len returns the number of items in the cache.

func  Len(checkExpired bool) int

title: ARC.Purge
content:
Purge is used to completely clear the cache

func  Purge()

title: ARC.Remove
content:
Remove removes the provided key from the cache.

func  Remove(key interface{}) bool

title: ARC.SetWithExpire
content:
Set a new key-value pair with an expiration time

func  SetWithExpire(key, value interface{}, expiration time.Duration) error

title: type Cache
type CacheBuilder
CacheBuilder.LoaderExpireFunc
content:
Set a loader function with expiration.
loaderExpireFunc: create a new value with this function if cached value is expired.
If nil returned instead of time.Duration from loaderExpireFunc than value will never expire.

func  LoaderExpireFunc(loaderExpireFunc LoaderExpireFunc) *CacheBuilder

title: CacheBuilder.LoaderFunc
content:
Set a loader function.
loaderFunc: create a new value with this function if cached value is expired.

func  LoaderFunc(loaderFunc LoaderFunc) *CacheBuilder

title: type FakeClock
type Group
Group.Do
content:
Do executes and returns the results of the given function, making
sure that only one execution is in-flight for a given key at a
time. If a duplicate comes in, the duplicate caller waits for the
original to complete and receives the same results.

func  Do(key interface{}, fn func() (interface{}, error), isWait bool) (interface{}, bool, error)
